#define SKIP_LINE(parser)                                                       \
     (IS_CRLF(parser->buffer) ?                                                 \
      (parser->mark.index += 2,                                                 \
       parser->mark.column = 0,                                                 \
       parser->mark.line ++,                                                    \
       parser->unread -= 2,                                                     \
       parser->buffer.pointer += 2) :                                           \
      IS_BREAK(parser->buffer) ?                                                \
      (parser->mark.index ++,                                                   \
       parser->mark.column = 0,                                                 \
       parser->mark.line ++,                                                    \
       parser->unread --,                                                       \
       parser->buffer.pointer += WIDTH(parser->buffer)) : 0)
